newsitem.title: USA: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc oper income rises.
newsitem.headline: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc oper income rises.

text.p: NOTE: 1996 Q4 operating income was $62.3 million or $0.62 excluding items.

The oper EPS excludes a gain of $260.5 million after taxes, or $2.61 a share on the exchange of Shepard's for the Times Mirror Higher Education Group. Oper is also before a $14.9 million charge or $0.15 a share to integrate the College division with the higher education business.
Dilution, which cut EPS by $0.05, is included in the items above.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 operating earnings were $250.1 million or $2.50 a share, excluding the net gain from the Shepard's and the charge from the integration.
Share data reflects a two-for-one stock split approved by the board of directors on January 31, 1996. 1995 has been restated to reflect the split.
Consensus estimates of fourth quarter earnings were $0.59, according to First Call.
